scope: Native authored foot-route door assistance without movement takeover
finding: Door interaction had production callers for explicit clearance/garrison and finite indoor actors, but no automatic ordinary authored-travel caller. A native route could approach a recognised unlocked door without those controllers offering the existing interaction. This does not identify a historical screenshot root cause.
intent: Preserve native movement/planning while supplying a nearby physical interaction; build the door affordance below larger CQB/routing behaviours rather than replacing the path controller.
implementation: Existing CALM group tick calls CortexRouteDoors before the independent Contact toggle. Minimum2s gap, rotating16actor roster, one3m forward geometry probe, selecting only the first blocking House or proxy parent. No danger/response/group movement owner. Reject nonplain waypoint types/conditions/scripts/timers/attachments/synchronisation before query. ROUTE context binds group/epoch and revalidates native MOVE/goal/current features/availability at animation; current combat targets, actor reservation and STEALTH/CARELESS veto. Existing3m/floor/lock/visibility/transform/eye geometry guards remain. New0.8m forward native-goal-line gate is rechecked at mutation. No movement or access credit.
cost: One3m geometry probe plus at mostfour existing door visibility rays per sample, on existing tick cadence with minimum2s gap and rotating16actor roster. No nearby-building radius query, new worker/timer, group cadence change or enemy-position scan. Actual overhead unmeasured.

validation.fullPipeline: 1477 tests and all sequential compiler/FSM/config/docs/parity/performance/package gates passed.

limits: A straight current-goal line is conservative and is not the native planned path. Bent paths can miss assistance; a nearby visible door aligned with the goal may be opened even if the engine would walk around. Only recognised unlocked door sources are supported. No complete through-building navigation, accessible interior, coherent pair entry or room clearance claim. Geometry without a detectable closed-door surface can receive no assistance; empty probe is no clearance proof.

engineReferences.evidence: Radius membership is measured from model centre; unsuitable for identifying only nearby door surfaces on large structures.
First intersection returns direct object and proxy parent, in ASL. This identifies the encountered geometry, not a navigable route.
